SCENE 05 — Understanding beside a campfire after dark — edit5.200s (20.600–25.800s)
Setting: A small campsite on an open ridge at blue hour, with a low stone-ring campfire, a simple muted-ochre canvas tent in the far upper-right, packed mauve-gray earth and broad distant blue hills. An open slate-blue evening sky replaces the enclosed woodland or indoor walls. Cool ambient evening light and gentle local amber firelight; no stars, flying embers or decorative particles.
Framing: Medium-wide full-body shot at Sol face height, slightly downward. Sol stands on SCREEN-RIGHT at x=66%, height38%, feet y=76%; a low campfire occupies SCREEN-LEFT at x=28%, y=64%, with a clear gap from Sol. The small tent is distant, at x=77%, y=38%; hills and open sky form broad simple layers. Fixed camera. Quiet lower fifth for editable captions.
First frame: Sol stands on solid packed earth beside the campfire, both tiny feet supported and both short rounded arms lowered at his flanks. His compact body is angled shallowly toward the fire on screen-left, with both original dark oval eyes visible. A small contained flame burns on three charred pieces of wood inside a low ring of stones; no people are present.
Action: During Sol's sentence, open both short arms once into the small low understanding gesture, with gentle attached body/tip follow-through and unchanged limb lengths. By local3.6s, tilt the whole compact body and attached face slightly upward toward the fixed Narrator point above camera. Maintain that gaze, low open arms and gentle listening idle throughout Arthur's Right at4.0–4.9s and the ending. Keep feet supported; no face slide, eye squish, mouth, particles or hops. The low fire remains fixed to its logs.
Last frame: Exactly the same campsite, camera, Sol scale, ground contacts, tent, hills, stones and three wood pieces. Sol holds both stubby arms slightly open in a low gesture of understanding. His compact body, filled flame layers and attached face tilt gently backward/up together toward the fixed Narrator point just above camera. Preserve original tall close-spaced navy oval eyes, broad cream inner flame, unchanged limb lengths and supported feet.
Sol: “So finding fire wasn't the same as making it.”
Narrator: “Right.”
Speaker cues: Existing05-01-sol at0.080–2.914s; original-release05-02-narrator at4.000–4.900s. Unchanged1x; preserve final picture through5.2s.

Next cut: Hold the clear upward listening pose through the complete Right release and existing music fade; no additional scene.
